blocks.content: This closing topic traces the complete path from an application's DNS lookup to an actual request landing on a real Pod, tying together everything covered across the Services and Networking modules into one coherent, end-to-end picture.
1. The Complete Path, at a Glance
blocks.text: 1. The Complete Path, at a Glance

blocks.content: An application does a DNS lookup for a Service name, that lookup routes to CoreDNS, CoreDNS resolves it to the Service's virtual IP, the application connects to that virtual IP, and kube-proxy's rules redirect the actual traffic to a real, currently healthy Pod.

blocks.alt: The entire path, from a simple DNS lookup to a real, live Pod actually receiving the request

blocks.content: The application performs an ordinary DNS lookup, which its resolv.conf, configured exactly as covered in the Cluster DNS topic, automatically routes to the cluster's own internal DNS service.

blocks.alt: The DNS lookup mechanics covered in full in the Cluster DNS topic

blocks.content: CoreDNS, covered in its own dedicated topic, actually answers the query, resolving the requested Service name to that Service's stable virtual IP, exactly the naming scheme first covered in the Services module.

blocks.alt: The exact resolution mechanics covered in the CoreDNS topic

blocks.content: 4. Step 4: Connecting to the Virtual IP
blocks.text: 4. Step 4: Connecting to the Virtual IP

blocks.content: The application now has a real, stable virtual IP and simply connects to it directly, entirely unaware that anything beyond an ordinary network connection is about to happen.

blocks.alt: A completely ordinary-looking connection, from the application's own point of view

blocks.content: 5. Step 5: kube-proxy Delivers the Real Connection
blocks.text: 5. Step 5: kube-proxy Delivers the Real Connection

blocks.content: This is the final, concrete step, exactly the mechanism covered in the Pod-to-Service Communication topic, kube-proxy's rules intercept traffic to that virtual IP and transparently redirect it to one of the Service's real, currently healthy backing Pods, completing the entire trace.

blocks.alt: The final handoff, exactly the kube-proxy mechanism covered in the Networking module

blocks.title: Key Takeaway
points: This complete trace, DNS lookup, CoreDNS resolution, connecting to a virtual IP, and kube-proxy's redirect, ties together every piece of service discovery covered across this course.
Every step in this flow was covered individually elsewhere, seeing them chained together end to end is what makes the whole mechanism click into one coherent picture.
